terms.gloss: live on what is clear gain: live on borrowed time
evidence: Cic. Fam. 9.17.1: dē lucrō prope jam quadriennium vīvimus (Lewis & Short), s.v. lucrum
Liv. 40.8.2: dē lucrō tibi vīvere mē scītō (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Lewis & Short: “as by a miracle, in constant, imminent danger of death”. Each day is a profit one had no right to expect.

sources: Lewis & Short: lucrum · Lewis & Short: vivo
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 102, checked against the searchable text and the page image (12 November 2026).
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
